formal_statement: ∃ (x1 : ℕ),   ∀ (x2 : ℕ) (x3 : SimpleGraph (Fin x2)) [x4 : DecidableRel x3.Adj],     (∀ (x5 : Fin x2), x3.degree x5 = (0 : ℕ) ∨ (3 : ℕ) ≤ x3.degree x5) →       (∀ (x6 : Fin x2) (x7 : x3.Walk x6 x6), x7.IsCycle → (5 : ℕ) ≤ x7.length) →         have x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∀ (x8 : Fin x2 → Bool), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x2 x7 x8 = Bool.true → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun x3 ∅ x8 = Bool.true;         have x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Finset (Sym2 (Fin x2)) := fun (x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => {x9 ∈ x3.edgeFinset | (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x2 x8 fun (x10 : Fin x2) => Decidable.decide (x10 ∈ x9)) = Bool.true};         have x9 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → ℕ → Prop := fun (x9 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x10 : ℕ) => (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x9 x10).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ ∃ (x11 : Fin x2) (x12 : Fin x2), ¬x3.Adj x11 x12 ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal x2 x9 x10 (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput x11 x12) = Bool.true;         ∀ (x10 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x10 → x7 x10 → (∀ (x13 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x13 → x7 x13 → x13.size < x10.size → (x8 x13).card < (x8 x10).card) → (∃ (x14 : ℕ), x9 x10 x14) → ∃ (x15 : ℕ), x9 x10 x15 ∧ ∃ (x16 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x16 ∧ x7 x16 ∧ x16.size < x10.size ∧ x8 x16 = x8 { gates := PEqualNP.NotPremium.replaceByConst x10.gates x15 Bool.false, output := x10.output : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit } ∧ (x8 x10).card ≤ (x8 x16).card + x1 * (x10.size - x16.size)
plain_statement: There is a constant c such that for every graph with every degree 0 or at least 3 and no cycle shorter than 5: let C be a circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, true only where the edge function is true, such that every smaller circuit of that kind accepts fewer edges, and with some AND gate true at a non-adjacent pair. Then for one such gate, some smaller circuit of that kind accepts exactly the edges C accepts once that gate is replaced by false, and C accepts at most c more edges than it for each gate saved.
